title: 蛮神的低语
text: 祭坛上摆着一堆碎骨，血迹还没干透。你听见有人在耳边低吼：{b}杀，再杀。{/b}一枚骨制的护符从骨堆里滚到你脚边。

texts.en: A pile of shattered bones sits on the altar, the blood not yet dry. Something growls in your ear: {b}Kill. Kill again.{/b} A bone charm rolls out of the pile and stops at your feet.

outcomes.text: 蛮神的护符在掌心发烫。

texts.en: The Brute's charm burns in your palm.
